verdict.rationale: The product is a set of agent skills operated entirely through conversation with a coding agent. Skill descriptions trigger on plain-language intent, e.g. 'Use when the user wants to build features or fix bugs test-first, mentions red-green-refactor' and 'Use when the user wants to stress-test their thinking'. Users can also type a slash command, and skills like grilling and setup run as interactive dialogues that ask the user questions. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that natural-language triggering works reliably, and natural-language install/update (installation and updates go through CLI commands like `npx skills update` and `claude plugin install`).
